text: Is the mean NDVI over the whole patch above 0.5, meaning most of the patch is dense, healthy vegetation?
Is the mean NDVI over the whole patch below 0.2, meaning most of the patch is sparse or not vegetated?
Is open water present, meaning that in at least one cell of a 3 × 3 grid more than 5% of pixels have NDWI above 0?
Is vegetation denser in the left half than in the right half (higher mean NDVI on the left)?
Does the patch contain any Arable land, following the CORINE-based BigEarthNet land cover labels?
Does the patch contain any Mixed forest, following the CORINE-based BigEarthNet land cover labels?
Does the patch contain any Coniferous forest, following the CORINE-based BigEarthNet land cover labels?
Does the patch contain any Transitional woodland, shrub, following the CORINE-based BigEarthNet land cover labels?
Does the patch contain any Broad-leaved forest, following the CORINE-based BigEarthNet land cover labels?
Does the patch contain any Land principally occupied by agriculture, with significant areas of natural vegetation, following the CORINE-based BigEarthNet land cover labels?
Is the mean NDMI (B8A and B11) above 0.192, meaning the vegetation and soil are wetter than for a typical patch in this dataset?
Is the mean NDBI (B11 and B08) above 0, a sign of built-up or bare surfaces?
Is the mean NDMI higher in the top half than in the bottom half?
Is the near-infrared texture rougher than for a typical patch in this dataset, meaning the B08 spatial standard deviation exceeds 640.0?
Does the patch carry more than 3 BigEarthNet land cover labels?
Is the edge density higher than for a typical patch, meaning the mean absolute difference between neighboring B08 pixels exceeds 178.0?
Is the patch wetter than its visible and near-infrared appearance predicts, meaning its NDMI (B8A and B11) exceeds the value expected from its visible and near-infrared statistics?
